diffs.diff: pin count: part has 10 (TX RX NC GND +5V ANT1 ANT2 LED +5V2 GND2), datasheet reading has 5 (TX RX - GND +5V)
diffs.evidence: RDM630 Specification, '2. Pin definition' (TTL interface): 'P1: PIN1 TX, PIN2 RX, PIN3 (blank), PIN4 GND, PIN5 +5V(DC); P2: PIN1 ANT1, PIN2 ANT2; P3: PIN1 LED, PIN2 +5V(DC), PIN3 GND'. The module has three headers totalling 10 pins; the second reading listed only the 5-pin P1 host header. The model's first 5 pins match P1 exactly (NC = blank PIN3), and the extra 5 are P2 (antenna) and P3 (LED/+5V/GND), all marked optional.
